d:
Witness the incredible talent of rural India! In this emotional travel vlog from Ghatshila, we meet 'Kaki Ma,' an inspiring woman who builds and decorates her traditional village home (Mitti Ka Ghar) using nothing but her bare hands, an ingenious simple tool, and her extraordinary mind.
This is more than just a home—it’s a living museum of traditional art.
In this episode, you will discover:
How 'Kaki Ma' creates beautiful, intricate designs on her home’s exterior without any modern machinery.
